verdicts.reason: Quote states that every listed configuration is run and each runs all four SPI modes; scenario/coverage check, MUST fits.
Quote only says CFG-MIN uses divider 1 (SCLK = f(i_clk)/2) and runs all four modes. It is a configuration purpose, so a scenario check fits; 'both' is overreach.
Quote states CFG-MAX uses divider 255 and runs all four modes with short bursts; scenario check is appropriate.

questions.question: Do CFG-MIN and CFG-MAX also require full-length bursts, or only the short bursts stated for CFG-MAX?
Does the general SCLK formula f(i_clk)/(2*PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV) apply to the other dividers (4 and 255)? The quote gives it only for divider 1.
